**CRM: Vantorre Mobility — 5/12/26.** 48 seats, Tier 1 Plus SLA. Depot expansion is the big topic; dispatch wants the new staging lane visible in Pemberline Dock before they start routing overflow there. The morning shift keeps calling it “door zero,” which apparently makes sense onsite but looks wierd in the schedule. Asked for the actual door labels, not another phone pic of the whiteboard.

Next: check the lane setup and send a quick sched walkthrough. Still waiting on the depot sketch; recieved a cropped version without the entrance, so that’s not much help.
